clips.title: The story
paras: In southwestern Westfall, the Gold Coast Quarry has fallen to the Defias Brotherhood. The mine once supplied Stormwind with stone, minerals, and gold; now the Brotherhood draws on its remaining resources for its insurrection.

The Gold Coast Quarry once supplied Stormwind with stone and gold for the kingdom's rebuilding. After royal troops withdrew from Westfall, Defias highwaymen and renegade laborers seized the mine. Brotherhood patrols watch from its terraced ramps, which overlook the coast, and take what minerals remain to fund their rebellion.
